_comment: Source register for injury_lab/. A page may only cite a source listed here, and a source may only be
listed here if it was opened during session arena/7acec358-korea3 on the date in read_utc - or if the
attempt failed, in which case read is false and every value that would depend on it stays blank.
official-league      published by the NFL (nfl.com and its club-media CDN static.clubs.nfl.com).
official-club        published by an NFL member club on the club's own domain.
pinned-community     the third-party dataset this repository pins by commit and checksum. Not an
official publication; used only for market and result fields, and labelled as
such on every row that uses it.
repository-file      a file inside this repository, cited for recomputation rather than for fact.
No betting price from a sportsbook, no bookmaker page and no third-party depth-chart site is used
anywhere in this directory. The NFL does not publish lines, so lines come from the pinned community
dataset, and that is stated on every row rather than smoothed over.

sources.title: Official NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season | NFL.com
sources.supports: Per-player Week 10 2026 rows for the Thursday and the 9:30 AM and 1:00 PM Sunday fixtures: player name, position code, injury text, practice status, game status, each player linked to their official NFL.com player page; plus each club's win-loss-tie record as printed on the same page and the kickoff line for each fixture.
sources.does_not_support: Anything about a fixture in a later chunk of the page. Atlanta's player rows are in a later chunk, so this source says nothing about Atlanta's report - it does not say Atlanta reported no injuries.

sources.title: redirects to /injuries/league/2026/reg10
sources.supports: That no Week 11 2026 report URL resolved at retrieval time: the request was redirected to reg10. Used to state the limits of weekly automation, nothing else.
sources.does_not_support: Any Week 11 designation. There is nothing to support.

sources.title: Official NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2025 Season | NFL.com
sources.supports: That the official weekly report is week-addressable for past seasons: this URL returns the 2025 Week 1 report (heading 'Injuries - WEEK 1', fixtures dated Thursday 4 September 2025 onward) with per-player rows in the same shape as the current week. It also supports the Arizona club-code variant seen inside one page: the fixture line prints ARI while the logo asset path on the same line reads AZ.
sources.does_not_support: The page's own <title>, which says 'Week 10 of the 2025 Season' for a Week 1 page. See flag H02.

sources.title: Official NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2015 Season | NFL.com
sources.supports: The Week 10 2015 report for the Thursday and the first Sunday fixture, and the designation vocabulary of that season: Out, Doubtful, Questionable and Probable are all printed in the Game Status column. Also that the 2015 week selector offers a PRO BOWL entry that the 2026 selector does not.
sources.does_not_support: Any current-season claim about Probable. A rule written against the 2015 vocabulary is not a rule for 2026.

sources.title: 2026 Lions Depth Chart
sources.supports: An ordered depth chart with first, second, third and fourth names in adjacent columns per position group, labelled on the page '2026 Unofficial Depth Chart Compiled by Lions Football Communications'. Used for the string position of each named Lion and for who is printed next to an unavailable player.
sources.does_not_support: That any player is injured or unavailable - the page prints no availability. Also not a league designation, whatever the club's own 'Unofficial' label means: see flag H06.

sources.title: New England Patriots Unofficial Depth Chart
sources.supports: An ordered depth chart per position group, and - verbatim, in the club's own words - the disclaimer that the chart 'is unofficial and is published by the writers of Patriots.com', reflects 'the opinions of the Patriots.com writers' and does 'not necessarily reflect those of the organization'. Also the legend block that defines position codes, which is the only official definition of any position code in this capture set and is what injury_lab/conventions.py is built from.
sources.does_not_support: Any statement of the club's own intent for the ordering, because the page disclaims exactly that. Do not cite this chart as what the team plans to play.

sources.title: no title - server error
sources.supports: Only the fact that this host returned a server error at retrieval while the patriots.com host resolved. It is registered so that a failed URL is recorded as a failed URL and not later mistaken for an absent depth chart.

sources.title: Dallas Cowboys | Official Site of the Dallas Cowboys
sources.supports: An ordered depth chart headed 'Unofficial 2026 Dallas Cowboys Depth Chart', and the fact that the page prints no provenance statement at all about who compiled it.
sources.does_not_support: Any join to this repository's 2025 Cowboys report rows. Different season, refused and published as refused - see flag H16.

sources.title: 2025 Preseason Week 1 Dope Sheet
sources.supports: That a member club publishes a dated, numbered weekly document ('THE DOPE SHEET, OFFICIAL PROGRAM AND PUBLICATION', 'VOL. XXVII; NO. 3 PRESEASON GAME 1') on the NFL club-media CDN, and that its own contents listing carries a DEPTH CHART section with players ordered per position for a stated date. Also the 2025 schedule printed on the page, which includes a 'Sat./Sun., Jan. 3/4' fixture - the reason this lab will not infer a calendar year from a season number for late-season weeks.
sources.does_not_support: The depth-chart block itself: chunk 0 was not the page carrying it, so this lab publishes no fact from this document about depth ordering. Finding whether a dated chart exists for every club and week is an open question, not a conclusion.

sources.title: games.csv (pinned by commit, checksummed in data/raw/MANIFEST.json)
sources.extent: the file in this repository at data/raw/games.csv, hash matched by the repo's own fetch script
sources.supports: Game date, club codes, scores, spread and total lines, spread and total prices, moneylines, roof, surface, wind and temperature for every fixture this lab joins to. Every market and result value on every page here is from this file and is labelled third-party.
sources.does_not_support: Any claim about injuries, availability, depth charts or line origination. It is not an official publication, and the NFL does not publish lines, which is why this file is used for them at all.

sources.title: scripts/gates.py - the eight published validation gates
sources.extent: module docstring and constants, read from the working tree at main
sources.supports: The thresholds this family inherits: MIN_N 200, MIN_N_CONF 100, FDR_ALPHA 0.10, ECON_BAR 0.005, price stress at -115, second line source, empirical-Bayes shrunk edge.
sources.does_not_support: G1 meaning 'Provenance'. In this file G1 means sample size; docs/preregistration.md uses G1 for provenance. See flag H23.

sources.title: docs/preregistration.md - the second gate register
sources.extent: gate table and reward line, read from the working tree at main
sources.supports: The stricter sample requirement this family adopts (>= 300 bets, >= 8 seasons, >= 40 holdout bets), the 60% season-stability bar, and the rule that only strategies passing all gates are reward-eligible.
sources.does_not_support: Anything about injuries. This register predates every injury page in the repository.

sources.title: data/derived/gates_meta.json - published family statistics
sources.extent: the JSON file in this repository
sources.supports: family_size 18, universe 6827, fdr_alpha 0.10, econ_bar 0.005, the discovery window 2000-2015 and the confirmation window 2016-2026, and the published count of rules that cleared every gate: zero.
sources.does_not_support: This lab's own pilot. The six settled fixtures here are not in that universe.

sources.title: data/derived/corr_same_game.csv - measured same-game dependence
sources.extent: the CSV and its meta file in this repository
sources.supports: The published same-game spread-by-total dependence (phi = +0.0086, 95% CI -0.0162 to +0.0332) and the published parlay requirement it is measured against (phi >= 0.0975 at -110). Quoted as published values of an earlier build, with that build's own caveat about its season window attached.
sources.does_not_support: Any injury-driven leg correlation. No correlation involving an injury feature has been measured in this repository, which is why F07 and F08 are registered as blocked rather than tested.

sources.title: Official Latest NFL Injury Report for Players
sources.supports: That the unqualified live path resolves to the same week as I01 on the retrieval date, and that the week selector for 2026 offers WEEK 1 through WEEK 10 while the page body prints fixtures dated 12-15 November - the reason a refresh job must key on fixture dates.
sources.does_not_support: A Week 11 report. None had been published at retrieval time.

sources.title: decision_lab/data/injuries.json - Week 10 2026 report transcription, captured 2026-11-12
sources.extent: whole file, 254 player rows plus 14 fixture rows
sources.supports: The only prior record of the same official URL anywhere in this repository, and the comparison base for the cross-capture audit: its designations, practice statuses, injury text, player URLs and fixture records, as that session published them.
sources.does_not_support: Any re-verification. No raw page text was retained with this file, so its rows can be compared with a capture but cannot be checked against the page again. That asymmetry is flag H29, and the capture-date field 'captured_utc' (2026-11-12) is the only provenance the file carries.
